notes: Security-first fintech — must keep PII & model prompts in EU region only; data residency is a hard requirement.
Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with customer-managed keys (BYOK) and end-to-end encryption guarantees.
In-transit: require mutual TLS for all control-plane <-> data-plane comms; prefer TLS 1.3, mTLS using customer CA or Redwood-managed certs if customer provides CA chain.
mTLS details we discussed: per-service certs, short-lived certs (7d), automated rotation. Customer wants the option to rotate certs on their cadence and to revoke via CRL/OCSP.
At-rest: must use envelope encryption with a CMK in customer's AWS KMS; Redwood to support key-rotate and periodic re-encryption metadata; option for HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM) called out.
Key lifecycle: customer requires ability to rotate keys without downtime; Redwood to support staged rotation (dual-key read + write) and key rollover runbook.
Secrets management: customer standard is HashiCorp Vault. They want Redwood to support Vault-backed secrets for DB credentials, TLS keys, and API credentials (dynamic secrets ideal).
Audit logging: all access and admin actions forwarded to customer's Splunk/CloudWatch; immutable log stream + tamper-evidence. Retention controls configurable (30/90/365 days).

Data handling: 'we cannot have prompt logs retained beyond retention window' — customer asked for controls to truncate non-essential prompt text and to opt-out of long-term logging of sensitive fields.
Network constraints: their network security requests VPC peering with no public egress, strict CIDR allow list, and support for PrivateLink. They also require egress inspection via their firewall.
Procurement/Legal: need SOC2 + ISO27001 artifacts, security questionnaire answers, and a contractual clause for crypto key ownership and escrow.
Quote from CTO: 'We need cryptographic controls that we can audit end-to-end — bring-your-own-key is a must, but we also want a clear rollback plan.'
POC scope agreed: 2-week POC in eu-west-1, demonstrate BYOK CMK integration, mTLS between control plane and data plane, audit log forwarding to Splunk, and secrets retrieval via Vault.
Risk: customer's SRE team is concerned about latency bump from envelope encryption; Redwood Optimize team will measure p99 token latency impact in POC.
Action items: SE to produce KMS integration diagram + rotation runbook; Solutions to provide Vault integration sample; Legal to review BYOK clause by 2024-11-15.
